title: Seedwise three-CNF reduction
statement: Let $V$ be a PCPP system with Boolean alphabet, input length $n$, proof length $L$, and $r$ queries, and let $K$ be a positive integer. A seedwise three-CNF reduction assigns to every verifier seed a CNF formula on $r+K$ variables with exactly $K$ clauses, each having between one and three literals. For every seed and every queried-bit assignment, the verifier accepts exactly when there exists an assignment to the $K$ auxiliary sign variables that makes the formula evaluate to $-1$ on the extended assignment.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a PCPP system over Boolean symbols
each seed is assigned a formula on $r+K$ variables
every clause has width at most three

a satisfying auxiliary sign assignment implies acceptance
